candidates.source_name: Bankart d.o.o. — Plačilni sistemi in storitve (payment systems & services)
candidates.why_relevant: Bankart is the central SI processor and operator of the BIPS / BIPS IP / SIMP-PS payment systems used by essentially every Slovenian bank and savings bank. This section is the operator's own description of the systems it runs and is the anchor page from which its scheme/participant documentation is published.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic HTML crawl of the section plus /wp-content/uploads/ PDF discovery; diff page text to catch new scheme documents.
queries_used: Bankart pravila sheme Flik takojšnja plačila udeleženci
Bankart aktualno novice obvestila udeležencem plačilnih sistemov

candidates.source_name: Bankart — Opis plačilnih sistemov za procesiranje SEPA transakcij (SL/EN, versioned PDF)
candidates.why_relevant: The closest public equivalent to a scheme/system rulebook: describes BIPS, BIPS IP (domestic SCT Inst), BIPS T (cross-border instant via TIPS) and SIMP-PS, participation eligibility, settlement and financial-risk arrangements. Republished under a dated filename, so version deltas expose operational and compliance changes for participants.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Track the dated-filename pattern (Opis-placilnih-sistemov-...YYYY-MM-DD_SLO/ENG.pdf); download each new edition and text-diff against the prior one.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search on document title + snowball from operator site
queries_used: Bankart "Opis plačilnih sistemov" SIMP Bips IP dokument poravnava TIPS

candidates.source_name: Bankart — Aktualno (operator news & participant notices)
candidates.why_relevant: Operator's own news channel; the natural place where scheme releases, migration milestones and Flik/BIPS changes are first announced to the SI market. Low volume, high signal-to-noise for operational deadlines.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Weekly HTML scrape of the listing page; check for an RSS/WP feed at /aktualno/feed/ (WordPress-backed site, feed likely but unverified).
queries_used: Bankart aktualno novice obvestila udeležencem plačilnih sistemov

candidates.source_name: Bankart — Flik Pay / Flik POS scheme-adjacent documentation (privacy rules, merchant onboarding, FAQ)
candidates.why_relevant: Flik is the SI national instant-payment scheme; the scheme rulebook itself is not public, but Bankart's Flik privacy rules, merchant onboarding manuals and FAQ explicitly reference 'pravila slovenske nacionalne sheme Flik' and carry versioned technical/operational requirements for PSPs and acquirers.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl the Flik subtree and the wp-content uploads folder; capture version numbers embedded in PDF titles (e.g. v4.0) as change signals.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + snowball from Bankart domain
queries_used: Flik takojšnja plačila pravila sheme Bankart Slovenija
Flik Pay flik.si pravila uporabe shema banke udeleženke

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije — Nacionalni svet za plačila (National Payments Council)
candidates.why_relevant: The single best actor map for this cell: the NSP membership list enumerates SI payment-system operators (Bankart, Dinit, Nexi Slovenija), card schemes (Mastercard, Visa), ZBS, ministries and user bodies. It is also the forum where national migration and scheme-change agendas are tabled before they become participant obligations.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Snapshot the members list quarterly for actor-map maintenance; poll the gradiva subpages for new minutes.
queries_used: Nacionalni svet za plačila Slovenija Banka Slovenije SEPA migracija odbor

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije — Gradiva sej Nacionalnega sveta za plačila (NSP meeting materials & minutes)
candidates.why_relevant: Confirmed minutes of ~38 sessions (latest referenced April 2026). Minutes routinely record scheme-migration timetables, UPN/UPN QR standard changes and instant-payment rollout status months before they appear as binding participant deadlines. Highest-yield SI-specific forward-deadline source in this cell.

candidates.suggested_collection_method: Navigate from the NSP hub page rather than hardcoding the deep path (bsi.si has migrated its URL scheme); harvest PDF minutes and run keyword extraction for 'rok', 'migracija', 'uskladit', 'shema'.

candidates.why_relevant: Defines the reporting obligations imposed on payment system operators (upravljavci plačilnih sistemov) and the licensing regime under ZPlaSSIED. candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative enumeration of who legally operates a payment system in SI and who holds payment-institution/EMI authorisations. This is the ground truth for the actor map of this cell — new entrants and withdrawn licences appear here first.

candidates.source_name: Združenje bank Slovenije (ZBS) — Standardi (technical standards, incl. UPN QR)
candidates.why_relevant: ZBS is the standard-setting body for the UPN / UPN QR national payment order. The 'Tehnični standard Univerzalni plačilni nalog UPN QR' published here is the binding technical specification whose version changes force issuer, printer, bank and software-vendor migration deadlines across the whole SI market.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch the standards listing plus the parallel SL page; hash the linked standard PDFs to detect revisions; also monitor /guidelines/ and /principles/.
queries_used: UPN QR standard nova različica rok Združenje bank Slovenije navodila

candidates.source_name: ZBS — SEPA section (scheme guidance, ISO 20022 XML manuals, UPN QR specs, SDD mandates)
candidates.why_relevant: The SI national SEPA adherence/implementation hub: ISO 20022 XML implementation manuals for SCT and SDD, UPN QR form specifications, SDD mandate templates. Effectively the national-migration body layer between EPC rulebooks and SI banks — where EPC rulebook release cycles get localised into SI participant obligations.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl page + attached manuals; version-diff ISO 20022 implementation guides against EPC rulebook release calendar.
queries_used: Nacionalni svet za plačila Slovenija Banka Slovenije SEPA migracija odbor

candidates.source_name: ZBS — news / obvestila on payment regulation implementation (Instant Payments Regulation, VoP)
candidates.why_relevant: ZBS publishes market-facing notices that state exactly when SI banks must have implemented scheme/regulatory changes (e.g. 9 October 2025 full instant-payment obligation and Verification of Payee, transitional period to 2027 for non-euro member states). These are the operational deadline announcements for the whole SI participant base.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll the ZBS news index weekly (check for WordPress feed); extract date entities from Slovenian text ('od 9. oktobra 2025', 'rok', 'prehodno obdobje').
queries_used: "uredba o takojšnjih plačilih" Slovenija banke rok 9. oktober 2025 preverjanje imena prejemnika VoP

candidates.source_name: UPN QR — upn-qr.si (technical standard, issuer/printer certification, programmer guidance)
candidates.why_relevant: The operational portal for the ZBS-UPN-QR standard: technical standard text, QR specification (Version 15, 77x77, byte mode, EC level M), programmer instructions, verification library and the registered-issuer process via UJP. Also carries governance notices — e.g. the ZBS Payment Transactions Committee decision to shut down the QR/print verification centre — which are exactly the kind of operational change invisible in supervisory channels.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Full-subtree crawl with content hashing; specifically watch the technical-standard page and any 'obvestila' banner for version/deadline notices.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + snowball from ZBS standards page
queries_used: "upn-qr.si" navodila izdajateljem tehnični standard verzija

candidates.source_name: UJP — Uprava Republike Slovenije za javna plačila: e-računi portal & issuer rules
candidates.why_relevant: UJP operates the public-sector e-invoicing rail and receives the 'Izjava o sprejemu pravil za izdajanje obrazca UPN' from registered UPN QR issuers. It also sets e-SLOG standard version cut-offs (e.g. e-SLOG 1.6/1.6.1 withdrawn 1 Oct 2020 in favour of 2.0) that are hard deadlines for banks, PSPs and ERP vendors.

candidates.source_name: Halcom — payment-software vendor release & upgrade notices (Hal E-Bank, MultiPay)

Its release notices are a high-fidelity leading indicator of scheme/regulatory deadlines because they name the exact cut-off date and the exact functional change (e.g. from 9 Oct 2025 older mBanka/MultiPay versions blocked; instant payments plus automatic recipient verification for SEPA payments). Vendor deadlines often surface before bank-side communication.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Poll support.halcom.com FAQ/release pages and halcom.si product pages; extract version numbers and effective dates; mirror the versioned PDF manuals.

negative_findings.description: No publicly published Flik scheme rulebook ('pravila sheme Flik' / 'pravilnik sheme') was found on bankart.si or any SI bank site, despite bank privacy notices explicitly citing 'pravila slovenske nacionalne sheme Flik'.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched in Slovenian for scheme rules, participant rules and adherence documents; only derived artefacts surfaced (bank general terms, privacy rules, merchant onboarding manuals). The rulebook appears to be distributed only to adhering participants.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Flik participant deadlines must be reconstructed indirectly from bank terms, Halcom/vendor release notes and Bankart notices; no single authoritative public deadline document exists for this scheme.

negative_findings.description: Bankart's participant-facing area ('Poslovno' / poslovni portal) was not reachable as open content; no public index of participant circulars, release calendars or scheme change notices was located.
negative_findings.result_summary: Site navigation fetch listed a 'Poslovno' section, but no open document repository or release-calendar page was found behind it via search or direct fetch.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The hardest operational deadlines for SI banks (release windows, mandatory upgrade dates) most likely live behind this gate, so this cell has a structural blind spot that only indirect sources can partly cover.

negative_findings.description: Several bsi.si deep paths under /financna-stabilnost/nadzor-placil-in-infrastruktur/... and /placila-in-infrastruktura/... returned HTTP 404 on fetch while still being surfaced by search engines; an azurewebsites.net staging mirror of bsi.si also appears in results.
negative_findings.result_summary: Three separate deep-path fetches to bsi.si returned 404; the parent hub pages fetched fine.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for this cell must crawl bsi.si from section roots rather than persisting deep URLs, otherwise the pipeline will report false 'dead source' verdicts. These are hypotheses of URL migration, not evidence the pages are gone.

negative_findings.description: The UPN QR verification centre (Center za preverjanje pravilnosti QR kode in tiska obrazcev UPN QR) is reported as no longer operating, following a decision of the ZBS Payment Transactions Committee (Odbor za plačilni promet ZBS).
negative_findings.result_summary: Found stated on upn-qr.si-derived content; the ZBS committee decision itself was not located as a public document.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Governance of the UPN QR standard is changing; the ZBS Odbor za plačilni promet is a decision-making body whose outputs are only partly public and should be treated as a named target for future scouting.

negative_findings.description: Dinit d.o.o. is listed as a payment system operator / NSP member, but no operator website section describing its payment system, rulebook or participant obligations was found in either Slovenian or English search.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in sl for 'Dinit plačilni sistem upravljavec' returned only legal-framework and NSP membership references, no operator documentation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: An authorised SI system operator in this cell currently has no tracked primary source; the Banka Slovenije operator register must be used as the entry point instead.

negative_findings.description: No standalone official Flik scheme domain (e.g. flik.si) was confirmed; all authoritative Flik content found sits under bankart.si or on participant bank domains.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched 'Flik Pay flik.si pravila uporabe shema banke udeleženke' in Slovenian; results resolved to bankart.si and bank sites only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection should be anchored on bankart.si + bank sites; assuming a scheme-branded domain would create a phantom source.

coverage_gaps.description: Scheme rulebooks and release calendars for Flik, BIPS/BIPS IP and SIMP-PS are participant-only; the public web exposes only descriptions and derived terms.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Escalate to a relationship/contact-based acquisition route (Bankart prodaja@/info@, or via an adhering bank) and, in the meantime, treat vendor release notes plus bank general terms as the deadline proxy layer.

coverage_gaps.description: No RSS/Atom or structured change feed was confirmed for bankart.si/aktualno, zbs-giz.si news, or upn-qr.si; monitoring will depend on scraping and content hashing.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe standard WordPress feed endpoints (/feed/, /aktualno/feed/) during the verification pass; otherwise implement content-hash diffing with Slovenian date-entity extraction.

coverage_gaps.description: Card-scheme-side operators in SI (Nexi Slovenija, the Activa clearing system operated by Banka Intesa Sanpaolo) are identified but have no confirmed public rulebook or participant-notice channel.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Cross-check the Banka Slovenije operator register and licensing pages to enumerate every authorised SI payment system, then scout each operator's site individually in a follow-up cell.

coverage_gaps.description: Outputs of the ZBS Odbor za plačilni promet (Payment Transactions Committee) — the body that decides UPN QR standard and verification-infrastructure changes — are not published in an indexed, dated form.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Watch ZBS news and NSP minutes for references to committee decisions; consider requesting the committee's published decisions from ZBS directly.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language equivalents exist mainly for the Bankart system description PDF and parts of the ZBS site; scheme deadlines, minutes and vendor notices are Slovenian-only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Design the pipeline as Slovenian-first with machine translation for triage; do not rely on EN pages for deadline detection.

brief: Slovenia's payments market infrastructure is concentrated: Bankart d.o.o. operates the BIPS, BIPS IP (domestic SCT Inst), BIPS T (cross-border instant via TIPS) and SIMP-PS systems used by effectively all SI banks, with the Flik national instant-payment scheme layered on top, while Nexi Slovenija, Dinit and the Activa card-clearing system form a secondary operator tier. The binding scheme rulebooks are participant-only, so public visibility comes from three substitutable layers: Bankart's dated 'Opis plačilnih sistemov za procesiranje SEPA transakcij' PDF series, the ZBS standard-setting layer (UPN QR technical standard, upn-qr.si, SEPA implementation manuals) and the Banka Slovenije Nacionalni svet za plačila, whose minutes and 2024-2028 payment market strategy are the richest forward-deadline source. Practical deadline detection is best achieved indirectly, via vendor release notes (Halcom Hal E-Bank / MultiPay, which named 9 October 2025 as a hard cut-off for IPR and Verification of Payee) and participant banks' 'splošni pogoji'. All meaningful content is Slovenian-language; English versions exist only for the Bankart system description and parts of the ZBS site, and several bsi.si deep paths returned 404 during scouting, indicating a site URL migration rather than dead pages.
